entries.mem0ai/mem0: This official Hermes Agent memory provider offers a universal layer for managing user, session, and agent states. It supports temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval, available as an Apache-2.0 self-hosted server or a managed cloud service.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: OpenViking is an official context database that organizes information as a virtual filesystem using viking:// URIs. It utilizes a three-tier L0/L1/L2 loading system and session archiving to achieve significant token reduction and task-completion gains.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: This platform provides persistent long-term memory for agents through a self-hosted knowledge graph engine built from text and code. It features automatic routing for graph, vector, and code retrieval to maintain context across multiple sessions.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: Gbrain serves as an opinionated agent brain that tracks entity relationships via a knowledge graph without requiring LLM calls. It emphasizes explicit fact storage with provenance and includes a synthesis layer for cited prose and gap analysis.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official memory provider that features a custom vector graph engine and byte-level deduplication for high-scale recall. It maintains user profiles with stable facts and recent activity while offering connectors for Google Drive, Notion, and GitHub.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight implements long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows that allow agent memory to learn over time. It supports over 25 LLM providers and is deployable via Docker, Kubernetes, or managed cloud environments.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: This library enables stateful agents by using background reasoning to update peer representations from session history. It integrates with MCP and other frameworks, supporting deployment through a managed service, local CLI, or Docker.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: This official provider treats memory as a git repository, offering version control features like branching and merging for markdown context trees. It utilizes a 5-tier retrieval system to achieve sub-100ms performance across 20 supported LLM providers.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: Mnemosyne is a zero-dependency memory system for Hermes Agents that relies only on pure Python and a SQLite database. It features episodic compression for sub-linear storage growth and supports sub-millisecond operations.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This seven-layer memory system utilizes Qdrant, Redis, and SQLite to manage structured facts and an auto-curated wiki. It employs a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize specific injected contexts during recall.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: Autocontext is a recursive self-improving harness that generates filesystem-first artifacts like traces and playbooks to assist with complex tasks. It provides interfaces for Python, TypeScript, and Pi extensions while integrating with various model providers.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: This plugin provides lossless context management for Hermes Agents using a hierarchical DAG and SQLite store. It includes specialized tools like lcm_grep and lcm_recall to ensure no messages are lost and specific details can be recovered.
entries.vshulcz/deja-vu: This tool retroactively indexes months of local session history from disk to provide millisecond lookups for coding agents. It ensures security by redacting keys and tokens during the indexing process of gigabytes of historical data.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: This self-hosted backend enables private cross-session persistence for Hermes Agent using Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis. It supports any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider or local inference servers for flexible deployment.
entries.plur-ai/plur: Plur utilizes a human-readable YAML engram format to store shared memory locally for multi-agent systems. It employs hybrid BM25 and embedding-based retrieval to inject context across global, team, and project-specific scopes.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: This local-first layer manages identity, secrets, and memory with a 97.6% accuracy rate on LongMemEval benchmarks. It automates memory construction from Discord, Obsidian, and office documents to provide portable state across multiple agent clients.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: ClawMem is an on-device context engine that operates entirely locally without cloud dependencies or API keys. It integrates via MCP and Claude Code hooks, utilizing hybrid BM25 and vector search for retrieval.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: This durable, file-based system uses a five-tier hierarchical SQLite schema and FTS5 search instead of vector databases or embeddings. It offers a five-package plugin family including an SDK, CLI, and a dedicated Hermes adapter.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This optimization tool reduces prefill latency by 1.5–3× and saves up to 36% of tokens through block reordering and deduplication. It provides native plugin support for the Hermes Agent ecosystem to accelerate long-context inference.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This plugin offers explainable retrieval by attaching 'why_retrieved' tags to every recalled memory while tracking contradictions and managing data hygiene. It can run as an embedded in-process execution or via HTTP backends for clusters.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: AgentCairn uses an Obsidian vault as the primary source of truth, storing durable memory as inspectable Markdown files with frontmatter. It employs a local DuckDB cache for hybrid search, ensuring memory remains daemonless and user-owned.
entries.JanYork/llm-wiki-cli: This agent-driven CLI serves as a machine interface for autonomously maintaining source-grounded knowledge without a vector database. It preserves citations and temporal links while supporting portable archives for merging data between stores.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This anticipatory memory system prefetches context by monitoring agent session logs in real-time. It utilizes SQLite-vec and GGUF models locally to provide an MCP-native server for major coding agent clients.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single memory kernel stack for Hermes Agent. It manages state using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to deliver purpose-built evidence packets for every agent query.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: This memory and context layer resolves live workspace states into verified facts to reduce prompt tokens by 94%. It provides local-first session history tracking and supports MCP-native integration via stdio or SSE servers.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: This reflective memory system utilizes semantic search through BM25 full-text indexing and ranked graph traversal. It features automated indexing for codebases and multimedia with OCR support, using edge tags to create bidirectional relationships between notes.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: Designed to reduce schema overhead, this tool uses local BM25 ranking to select relevant keywords for Hermes Agent v0.14.0. It includes a dashboard for tracking estimated token savings and supports native tool search functionality.
entries.conorbronsdon/claude-context-os: This Git-backed context layer provides a source-neutral migration workflow for coding agents like Claude Code and Codex. It manages reviewed context updates through a system of hash-checked proposals and receipts.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin uses a columnar .lbdb embedded graph database to surface high-priority memories via 1-10 importance ranking. It combines BM25 keyword search with named graph relationships and optional entity extraction.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This episodic memory plugin features an on-demand summarizer and supports immediate event deletion to prevent persistent summaries from affecting future recall. It provides a trace.jsonl audit log to track every prefetch and memory operation.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables agents to manage budget-bound wallets and process x402 payments using stablecoins across multiple chain families. The system operates without a backend, database, or API keys.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin indexes local artifacts such as scripts, cron jobs, and documentation to facilitate capability routing. It registers five native tools for searching and fetching artifacts while automatically generating tool routing notes.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: This provider enables durable cross-session memory through pre-turn context injection and session-end snapshots. It utilizes a local SQLite reliability layer and a write outbox to manage searching and updating agent state.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: Integrating Exabase M-1, this plugin provides self-organizing long-term memory with tools for manual storage and searching. It supports configurable query expansion and result reranking to optimize retrieval performance.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin adds deterministic slash commands and LLM-callable tools for private, local code memory. It requires a local SourceVault server to handle indexing, vector storage, and grounded Q&A for repositories.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This AI-native memory solution features AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and supports HNSW ANN, sparse, and FM-index retrieval. It can be executed via native Rust FFI or as an HTTP daemon and includes MinHash deduplication.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider offers 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal, utilizing a hybrid search approach that combines BM25, vector, and graph methods. It supports Hermes agents by implementing automatic context checkpointing during message compression to preserve information.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: This kit provides a file-based memory hygiene loop that uses a git-backed directory for versioned, diffable markdown storage without requiring a database. It features five slash commands and specialized curators to identify data rot or contradictions, proposing evidence-cited diffs for manual review.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework implements a subagent-driven development process to enable autonomous task execution. It enforces test-driven development and YAGNI principles while functioning as a plugin for various coding harnesses and CLIs.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: This local-first system generates web, mobile, and motion graphic artifacts with native support for the Hermes Agent runtime via DeepSeek Harness. It facilitates the export of design prototypes into multiple formats including HTML, PDF, PPTX, and MP4.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This repository provides 818 structured skills across 34 security domains, mapped to frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK, ATLAS, and NIST CSF 2.0. These skills are compatible with over 26 AI platforms, offering a comprehensive security layer for agent operations.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This skill converts codebases, infrastructure-as-code, and schemas into draw.io diagrams using natural language descriptions. It supports incremental synchronization to preserve manual layouts and is accessible via a CLI or an optional MCP server.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Serving as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, this skill manages natural-language mandates, ERC-7710 permissions, and x402 payments. It integrates a master router with verification and dispute resolution layers to facilitate secure autonomous transactions.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This tool audits and rewrites content to eliminate detectable AI patterns using a 112-entry word replacement table and 74 pattern categories. It offers detect-only, rewrite, and edit-in-place modes to refine the structural and conversational quality of agent output.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This agentic evolver automates skill deduplication and quality improvement across sessions for Hermes and other OpenAI-compatible APIs. It includes a bilingual dashboard for inspecting session traces and monitoring the collective evolution of agent skills.
entries.wondelai/skills: This library provides 51 expert frameworks and 14 guided metaskills compatible with Claude Code and agent-plugins.org specifications. It maintains persistent session state within a project's documentation folder to ensure continuity across agent tasks.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection features 1,174 professional skills distributed as human-readable markdown files that run natively in Hermes Agent and Claude Code. The library includes ready-to-paste exports for other assistants like ChatGPT, Gemini, and Cursor.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This skill set enables Hermes Agent to perform video searches, browse channels, and extract transcripts or playlist data. It requires a TranscriptAPI key and is compatible with multiple agent environments including OpenClaw and Windsurf.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: This meta-skill plugin automatically detects reusable patterns in active workflows to propose and generate new skills. It produces both SKILL.md documentation and Python scaffolds, allowing users to manage these new capabilities via slash commands.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project teaches Hermes Agent to write its own analytical prompts and custom thinking instructions for specific tasks. It utilizes pre-built analytical lenses and generates reports that highlight potential analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This project provides type-safe support for remote skill registries using Git and S3 sources. It includes sandboxed execution to isolate untrusted scripts from the host while offering tools for reading bundled resources.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: These skills transform rough concepts into structured design documents and implementation handoffs for Hermes Agent. The workflow features a spec review gate with PASS/FAIL evaluation models and offers Lite or Full modes depending on project complexity.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This literate programming skill enables agents to weave prose, diagrams, and source code into .lit.md files. It uses a tangler to extract runnable source files and automatically syncs edits from those files back into the primary documentation.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Maestro is a local-first harness for long-running agents that utilizes a Git-based architecture and the SLP cooperative-agent protocol. It organizes operations through a three-layer system consisting of a mechanism kernel, plugins, and Markdown-based recipes.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin facilitates cross-instance shared memory by capturing high-value decisions and outcomes in markdown files. It establishes a pipeline for fine-tuning and switching to replacement models based on recorded work history.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This community-driven repository provides Hermes Agent skills, installation guides, and integrations specifically in Portuguese. All skills follow the SKILL.md format and adhere to the agentskills.io standard.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: These skills enable agent interaction with oracle networks and smart contracts, supporting CCIP, Data Feeds, VRF, and Data Streams. The project follows the Agent Skills specification and is installable via the Vercel open skills ecosystem CLI.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: This official suite provides eight specialist skills for FLUX image and video generation, including API integration for polling and webhooks. It offers specific prompting guidelines to optimize output for the FLUX 3 video suite.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool converts repositories, documentation, and developer discourse into agentskills.io-compliant skills. It features automated workflows for briefing and testing while linking instructions directly to specific file lines or URLs.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: Skilldock is a registry for reusable AI skills that supports recursive dependency resolution during installation. It includes a Python client, a CLI, and commerce features powered by TON payments.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: Nika defines AI workflows as code using a YAML-based language with four verbs and a single Rust binary. This local-first tool includes a CLI to check, run, and trace task execution across OpenAI and Codex models.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: This skill enables autonomous execution of complex, multi-step tasks with real-time progress tracking. It ensures operational safety through built-in rollback procedures and checkpoints for recovery during long-running processes.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes Agent to manage files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts through standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It ensures secure communication over HTTPS using Nextcloud App Passwords and includes a guided setup script for credential validation.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: A progressive MCP client that utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage during agent interactions. It features a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and enables incremental discovery of server metadata and tool schemas.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: This project serves as a community hub for browsing and installing skills, fully implementing the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification. It operates autonomously on NVIDIA infrastructure and provides federated search integration across GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: This skill implements a five-layer retrieval system, including semantic embeddings and FTS5, to narrow skill lists before LLM calls. It is designed to reduce token usage and features graceful degradation if specific embedding models or dependencies are unavailable.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: An ADHD-friendly personal execution system that uses MCP connections for agent-driven scheduling and habit management. It stores data locally in a single SQLite file and provides interfaces via a React web app and an Expo-based Android application.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: A read-only adversarial bug-hunting skill that employs three parallel subagents to attack code from different angles. It triages findings through deterministic pre-scans and verifies vulnerabilities via proof-of-concept execution in a hardened sandbox.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin rewrites and scores prompts across various surfaces like CLI, Discord, and Telegram to reduce token usage by 20–80%. It supports 97 languages and evaluates prompt quality across five distinct dimensions.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: Inspired by Claude Code, this skill uses parallel agents focused on hygiene, clarity, and correctness to simplify code in languages like Python, Go, and Rust. It employs a tiered application process that includes a mandatory approval gate for changes.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project adapts verified procedures for task decomposition and evidence-based verification gates to ensure grounded agent investigations. It includes a systematic protocol for causal debugging and a Python goal engine for managing persistent task states.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: A C# and .NET implementation of the agentskills.io pattern that supports progressive disclosure via SKILL.md files. It integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI for tool-based loading and automatically registers common agent skill directories.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: A turnkey cybersecurity lab providing over 2,000 skills and 131 tools for network forensics and exploitation. It integrates 28 frameworks, including MITRE ATT&CK and NIST, to facilitate work with real exploits spanning 2015 to 2026.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: This toolkit adds session management and worktree recovery to provide memory between agent conversations and detect state drift. it also orchestrates parallel subagents for architectural reviews and includes scaffolding tools for developing new skills.
entries.Diabloluo/hermes-hud: This local-first dashboard provides real-time observability for Hermes Agent through 11 monitoring tabs, including token costs, session history, and error tracking. It enforces a strict read-only boundary with zero outbound telemetry to ensure data privacy while offering optional incident alerts via Telegram and Feishu.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This skill automates the creation of reproducible demo GIFs for repositories by generating recording scripts with vhs or Playwright. It manages the entire pipeline from rendering and compression to embedding the final optimized markdown into a README.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This tool generates Claude Code and portable agent skills from plain language while preventing technical debt through a validator that detects specification drift. It monitors official frontmatter specs weekly and uses CI-friendly exit codes to ensure skills remain compatible with current runtimes.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This CLI and MCP server enables agents to search a database of over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 skills. It facilitates the discovery and direct installation of tools and plugins for compatible clients like Hermes, Cursor, and Claude Code.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: This host-agnostic framework establishes a self-improvement loop by analyzing session history to identify and propose skill coverage gaps. It utilizes a local evaluation framework—including deterministic and LLM-judge gates—to verify updates without requiring external daemons.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: These skills provide deterministic path routing and Python interpreter selection across Windows, Git Bash, and WSL environments. The tool ensures environment-specific path syntax is used and verifies project-compatible runtimes without requiring new installations.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates USDC payments for HTTP 402 responses using protocols such as Pay Link, x402, and MPP. It is designed for compatibility with the agentskills.io standard and supports Hermes Agent and OpenClaw environments.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This collection provides specialized tools for Chinese language processing, including Douyin video transcription and OCR for structured document extraction. It also features a rule-based engine designed to remove common Chinese AI writing patterns from generated text.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: This project provides a functional quality seal by testing agent skills for structure, functionality, and security within isolated Docker containers. It issues cryptographically verifiable Ed25519 certificates to confirm that a skill is safe and operational.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This plugin allows users to earn USDC on the Base network by answering support bounties or hosting their own bounty boards via x402. It operates without accounts or API keys, using a dedicated wallet key and human approval to facilitate payments.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: This integration exposes 191 tools and five production-grade workflow skills through a hosted MCP server. It enables Hermes Agent to access structured web data across 31 different platforms.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This skill generates multi-scale Chinese news reports ranging from global events to street-level updates. It utilizes semantic memory to integrate user interests and applies quality gates to produce structured analysis and action suggestions.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides Nix packages for various AI-powered coding agents, including Hermes, with support for both open-source and unfree licensed tools. The packages are automatically updated on a daily basis to ensure users have access to the latest versions.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: This repository offers an automated installer and configuration guides for running Hermes Agent and other CLIs on ARM64 Android devices via Termux. It leverages Termux:API and Termux:GUI to provide the agent with direct access to smartphone hardware and user interface elements.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This tool utilizes a proot-distro Ubuntu environment to install Hermes Agent on Android devices through an automated Termux script. It supports interactive model setup, shell command execution, and integration with both local Ollama models and external providers.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community-driven Helm chart enables the deployment of Hermes Agent on Kubernetes with a focus on single-writer state safety for persistent storage. It supports both direct deployments and operator-ready workflows, featuring configurable gateway modes for API and webhook listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: Providing a one-command installer for both Android and iOS, this project brings Hermes to mobile platforms via Termux and iSH. It integrates with Telegram for voice and file messaging and allows for the scheduling of tasks using cron jobs.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: This project implements hardware-enforced sandboxing for Hermes Agent using NVIDIA OpenShell to restrict network and filesystem access at the kernel level. Users can define specific security policies to govern the agent's messaging capabilities and web search activities.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane designed to deploy and operate Hermes agents on Docker and Kubernetes using Helm charts. It features a comprehensive credential catalog, integrations for over 17 LLM providers, and mandatory AES-256-GCM encryption for all secrets.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project provides a Docker sandbox image that includes the official Hermes installation and supports persistent state through mounted home directories. It allows users to build specific Hermes versions by utilizing build arguments during the image creation process.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This repository offers a Nix package and NixOS module for reproducible Hermes deployments using declarative configurations for workspaces and settings. It features a hybrid skill management system and integrates with sops-nix and systemd for secure secrets handling.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-first control plane that manages multiple Hermes Agent instances with separate workspaces and RBAC-controlled access. It facilitates inter-agent delegation through hierarchy-aware communication and provides enterprise MCP access for external AI clients.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: Designed for production-ready headless operation on Ubuntu and Debian, this project configures the Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service. It is optimized for the autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs and integrates with Nous Portal.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: This portable distribution allows Hermes Agent to run from a USB drive or any external storage without host installation or registry modifications. It bundles Python, PortableGit, and rescue tools, supporting Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes within isolated data environments.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework deploys specialized agents to conduct fundamental, sentiment, news, and technical analysis for financial trading. It utilizes structured debates between bullish and bearish researchers to assess risk and supports multiple LLM providers including OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and DeepSeek.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This self-hosted orchestration platform governs agent registration, task dispatching, and cost tracking across multi-agent workflows. Users can manage agents via a Web UI, CLI, or MCP server, with support for local Node.js installation or Docker deployment.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This control surface manages multiple coding agents, including Hermes Agent and Claude Code, through TUI and web dashboards. It features container-based isolation, Git worktree management, and persistent sessions via tmux for background execution.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This execution engine is the first to manage Hermes agents on the Solana blockchain using the Claude-style MCP protocol. It detects HTTP signals to handle payment-required states for paid APIs and supports scaling from single VPS agents to orchestrated teams.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: This template uses a level-based architecture and a task bus pattern to scale Hermes Agent from a single instance to automated specialist teams. It includes bundled skills for technical operations such as VPS provisioning, security auditing, and backup management.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This orchestration tool enables the creation of autonomous swarms with durable memory and visual org charts for team delegation. It supports over 23 LLM providers and integrates MCP tools to expand agent capabilities.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control interface allows users to supervise autonomous Hermes Agent work through a Kanban board and human-in-the-loop verification. It provides live streaming of agent reasoning and tool execution to facilitate the review of task completions.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This system coordinates 17 specialized agents across a strict pipeline architecture for research, planning, and infrastructure tasks. A Master Orchestrator manages the routing and coordination of these agents to ensure structured project implementation.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This local web system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents using Hermes Agent profiles and the MCP and ACP protocols. It features a real-time UI for monitoring agent dialogues and managing task lifecycles via a Hermes Kanban board.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-optimization framework automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code for Hermes Agent. It orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This arena orchestrates nine autonomous agents across two competing AI companies to battle for GitHub stars. It utilizes Paperclip and Hermes Agent for task execution and learning, visualized through a real-time scoreboard and task dashboard.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: This fully-local framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack using Hermes for task routing and tool-calling on consumer GPUs. It is optimized for RTX 4080/5080 hardware and runs via Ollama to eliminate cloud dependencies.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool provides a local, pre-indexed code knowledge graph that reduces token usage and tool calls for Hermes and other coding agents. It operates without a Node.js runtime and supports cross-file resolution for languages including TypeScript, Python, Go, and Rust via an MCP server integration.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: A CLI utility designed to track token usage and costs across multiple AI coding agents, including Hermes and Claude Code. It features a 3D visualization dashboard and extracts data from local session logs or SQLite databases to monitor expenses.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer allows developers to inspect API traffic from coding agents like Hermes, Codex, and Gemini. It exports sessions into a self-contained HTML viewer and automatically redacts common authentication headers to ensure security during recording.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This real-time widget monitors token usage, account limits, and session details by reading the state of Hermes Agent and other CLIs directly. It supports multi-device synchronization, allowing developers to track usage data across several machines simultaneously.
entries.bergside/typeui: This project provides design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers to assist in building user interfaces with AI. It integrates with Hermes Agent and other providers that support markdown or general prompting to streamline UI development.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: An opinionated workflow layer that coordinates seven specialized agents and loads 36 skills for building and operating applications. It supports autonomous execution on both laptops and VPS environments to enhance the Hermes Agent lifecycle.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: This project offers community-driven CLI skins and themes to customize the Hermes terminal user interface. Users can modify banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art using YAML-based configurations to achieve aesthetics ranging from retro DOS to cyberpunk.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: A native port of the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to the Claude Code Channel, eliminating the need for external processes or OAuth. It includes specialized MLOps tools for vLLM, GGUF inference, and reinforcement learning training.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: An AI-native browser built for autonomous agent control that features a supervisor sidebar for managing approvals and checkpoints. It supports external MCP clients and browser automation workflows across various AI providers including Anthropic and OpenAI.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This social economy platform enables autonomous agents to communicate via encrypted Signal Protocol messaging and register human-readable handles. It facilitates agent-to-agent commerce using Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This project provides memory integrations for frameworks like LangGraph and CrewAI using a two-tier system of knowledge graphs and session caches. It extends these capabilities to chat platforms including Telegram, Slack, and VS Code.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: A preconfigured setup for Hermes Agent that utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings. It includes over 40 skills for finance and devops, featuring automated installation for macOS and Linux.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: This framework enables the creation of scoped Hermes Agents by utilizing per-folder configurations, local memories, and custom instructions. It allows users to seamlessly switch between default and scoped agents while managing project-specific skills and tools.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: A static analysis tool that flags overlapping tool descriptions and inconsistent schemas in AI agent configurations without using LLMs. It supports Python 3.10+, provides HERM v1.1 scoring, and integrates with CI pipelines via SARIF output.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool automates the installation of a Hermes Agent stack and 12+ supporting services across three scalable deployment tiers. It facilitates a zero-cost setup with support for 29 community plugins categorized into six functional areas.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: A migration utility designed to transition OpenClaw assets, including SOUL.md and memory archives, into Hermes-compatible YAML and JSON formats. It handles nested authentication structures and sets up systemd gateway services for the migrated agent.
entries.observeco/observeco: This self-healing observability tool uses a native Hermes plugin to export real-time telemetry and monitor multi-agent systems without cloud dependencies. It detects performance drift using config-aware baselines and offers both passive analysis and active probing modes.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: A deterministic, zero-network local runtime designed to help users generate revenue through Hermes Agent by managing contracts for opportunities and offer-previews. It prioritizes security by requiring explicit approval for all external writes and consequential actions.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: This plugin adds offline voice capabilities to Hermes Agent, supporting 35 languages via Piper and 9 via Kokoro without requiring API keys. It features a wake-word enabled open mic, adaptive turn-taking, and barge-in functionality.
entries.181079342/hermes-memoss: A memory plugin for Hermes that provides tools for semantic search and multi-dimensional storage of agent memories. It includes a built-in circuit breaker to maintain stability during MemOS API outages while supporting memory addition and deletion.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: Built with the Tauri 2 framework, this cross-platform manager supports Windows, macOS, and Linux. It serves as an all-in-one tool for managing configurations for Hermes Agent alongside other CLI tools like Claude Code and Gemini CLI.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: This local open-source cowork application features a built-in agent engine with full file read and write access. It enables 24/7 automation via Cron and supports remote access through a WebUI and various messaging platforms.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: Developed using Python and vanilla JavaScript, this interface allows users to access Hermes Agent via web browsers or mobile devices. It includes a circular context ring for monitoring token usage and supports secure access through SSH tunnels.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: This desktop companion app streamlines the experience through guided installation and provider setup for Hermes Agent. It provides a graphical user interface for managing chats, sessions, tools, and multiple AI providers.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: This web dashboard manages AI chat sessions across ten integrated communication platforms and supports visual workflows with approval gates. It provides usage analytics, scheduled jobs, and profile-aware model selection for Hermes Agent.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace features a Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers. It integrates a Monaco-based file browser, a PTY terminal, and specialized panels for memory browsing and MCP catalog management.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: This collaborative workspace aggregates sessions from Hermes and other agents, supporting desktop, standalone server, and Docker deployments. It includes fifteen built-in agents and offers native iOS and Android clients for remote access.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: Designed as a native Mac workspace, this tool provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts. It features an embedded terminal for shell access and native views for managing sessions, Kanban boards, and cron jobs.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: Built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust, this Windows-first desktop application includes a built-in kernel with health check and update capabilities. The UI supports memory management and renders both LaTeX and Markdown.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension connects active browser context to local, cloud, or remote Hermes runtimes. It allows users to include or exclude specific tabs and supports multi-agent switching and group chats.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: This native SwiftUI app for iOS 18+ allows users to drive a self-hosted Hermes agent directly from an iPhone by pairing with a hermes-webui server. It manages agent chats, scheduled tasks, skills, and server files without third-party relays.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: This desktop workspace offers one-click setup for Hermes Agent and other engines, featuring a runtime dashboard to track token usage and latency. It provides a live workspace for monitoring code writes and diffs in real-time.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-hud: This interactive TUI consciousness monitor features nine tabs and four color themes for tracking agent growth and git projects. It provides a specialized tmux operator view for managing live agent panes and monitoring scheduled cron jobs.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard offers a browser-based terminal, file explorer, and a ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health and kanban pipelines. It includes an MCP server control plane for managing server lifecycles and visualizes tool calls during real-time streaming chat.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser that tracks per-session quota burn and estimated API costs across 15 agents. It allows users to search local prompts and command outputs while resuming supported CLI sessions in Terminal, iTerm2, or Warp.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS workspace facilitates one-click Hermes Agent installation on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It features an integrated WebRTC voice mode utilizing OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Built with Next.js 16 and Tailwind CSS v4, this dashboard template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web interface. It includes a dedicated approval inbox for managing agent requests that have side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: Built with OpenTUI, this alternative interface provides a TUI for chatting and managing Hermes Agent sessions. It incorporates a kanban board for task management alongside tools for managing profiles, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: This mobile-first React SPA dashboard for Telegram Mini App v2.0 supports background agent spawning for up to five concurrent instances. It features terminal chat with file attachments and utilizes dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This portable Windows desktop application runs via embedded Python and Node.js runtimes without requiring installation or admin rights. It features a Tkinter GUI with granular permission controls and includes 100 tools for TTS, music, and ComfyUI automation.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: This glassmorphic web interface provides real-time log streaming and a task tracking dashboard for self-hosted assistants. It includes management tools for skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers alongside an integrated file browser.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: A monitoring dashboard focused on process transparency, offering real-time session activity and cost tracking. It allows for full inspection of conversation histories and skill source code, plus read-only monitoring of environment variables.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: This self-hosted workspace features a chat-first design with real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards. It includes an integrated marketplace for skills and MCP servers, supported by isolated profile management for separate memory and API keys.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This native desktop client orchestrates collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents and supports model switching. It features a Visual Skill Store with over 50 curated one-click installations and streaming SSE responses.
